stories.headline: Santoli: We are nearing a now-or-never moment for the AI trade to rebound
stories.summary: Market strategist warns that the artificial intelligence sector faces a critical juncture where recent underperformance must reverse. The commentary reflects growing pressure on mega-cap tech holdings that have driven equity valuations.
stories.why_matters: AI exposure is core to S&P 500 concentration risk; a rebound or renewed selloff would significantly impact index performance and sector rotation.

stories.headline: US stock futures gain as oil pulls back ahead of Fed decision
stories.summary: Equity index futures advanced as crude oil prices retreated, removing near-term inflation pressure before the Federal Reserve's upcoming monetary policy announcement. The move reflects market relief around energy costs heading into a critical policy event.
stories.why_matters: Oil pullback eases stagflation concerns and may support Fed's credibility on inflation control, influencing rate-path expectations.

stories.headline: SpaceX, Tesla and Anthropic may reshape the S&P 500—but not right away
stories.summary: Analysis explores whether private unicorns and disruptive firms could enter or change the composition of the benchmark index through IPO or acquisition. The timeline and conditions for such shifts remain uncertain amid current market conditions.
stories.why_matters: Index composition changes would alter sector weights and influence passive fund rebalancing flows; long-term equity narrative around innovation.

calendar.note: Federal Reserve monetary policy decision and forward guidance will directly set near-term rate expectations and risk-asset volatility.
Labor cost inflation data is a key input to Fed's inflation assessment and wage-price dynamics ahead of policy announcement.
EPU index reflects investor sentiment and policy risk; elevated readings may dampen equity and credit risk appetite around FOMC.

concept.title: Curve Steepening into FOMC: Rate Expectations Reset
concept.one_liner: Both 2Y and 10Y treasuries rose 4 bps in tandem, signaling modest repricing ahead of Friday's Fed decision while VIX compression reflects contained volatility.
concept.explanation: The parallel 4 bps move up the yield curve suggests markets are pricing mixed signals: oil pullback eases near-term inflation fears, yet AI-trade uncertainty and macro geopolitics (Iran strait, China governance) keep risk-off sentiment alive. With the 10Y at 5.00% and 2Y at 4.69%, the 31 bps spread remains relatively flat, indicating lingering rate-cut skepticism or recession anxiety. VIX at 18.39, down 1.06, shows investors are not panicked but cautious—consistent with a market awaiting Friday's FOMC guidance.
concept.market_link: Fed decision on 2026-10-30 will either confirm shallow rate-cut bets or extend hold expectations; any surprise could steepen or flatten the curve and trigger equity sector rotation away from AI-dependent high-beta names.

narrative: US equity index futures are modestly higher on crude oil pullback and contained volatility (VIX down, S&P +0.10%), but yield curve sits flat across 2Y–10Y at 5.00%–4.69%, signaling cautious positioning ahead of Friday's FOMC decision and a slate of labor/inflation data that will define near-term monetary policy.
